integrity: Analytical proof with finite independent reproducibility tests; no claim of outside validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the three explicit homogeneous fixed points are classified; other equilibria and global basins are not.
Strict Schur criterion leaves marginal/nonhyperbolic boundary dynamics unresolved.
The original paper uses an odd-numerator nonlinearity that differs from one historical Gumowski–Mira variant.
Earlier general spectral literature may supply an equivalent formulation; priority is not independently established.
title: Parity-selective equilibrium stabilization in a coupled Gumowski–Mira ring
